commands.path: create dataset apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create dataset reverse-ETL action
examples: pm surveycto create dataset apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new server dataset (a general-purpose, enumerator, or case-management dataset); low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create dataset record apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create dataset record reverse-ETL action
examples: pm surveycto create dataset record apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: adds a new record to a dataset; the field name set is dataset-defined (SurveyCTO's own DatasetRecordFieldMap has no fixed schema), so record_schema only requires the routing field dataset_id -- every other record property is sent verbatim as the record's field-name/value map; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create user apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm surveycto create user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new SurveyCTO server user AND sets their initial password in the same call; a credential-provisioning action, not an ordinary data mutation -- approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update dataset apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update dataset reverse-ETL action
examples: pm surveycto update dataset apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an existing dataset's metadata/configuration (the dataset type/discriminator itself cannot be changed after creation, per SurveyCTO's own API); external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update user apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm surveycto update user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an existing user's password and/or role; a credential-provisioning action when password is set -- approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
